Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.

Minor Use Permit No. MUP -2015-24 Applicant: Anthony Powell
Location: 405 N. Azusa Avenue (8611-015-028)
Minor Use Permit to allow a church (meeting facility) use in an existing legal non-conforming building located in the CAZ (Azusa Avenue Corridor) zone. The church does not have sufficient amount of parking and a parking agreement has been proposed. This is a continued item from the 2/10/16 Planning Commission Meeting. This project is categorically exempt from environmental review per Section 15301 Existing Facilities of CEQA (California Environmental Quality Act).
